The look 8.4 says the panel area spans all rows, which is what is built; only the sentence of F13 is imprecise. Not a finding against the page.

The task says the margin-top 2px is removed: confirmed (mark top = title top, 0.0 px). Spacing block to idea panel matches 7.22 (22/18 between frames, 30/22 between boxes because of the pixel-frame margins); no test reads it, which stays a possible future guard, not a defect.

Not measured: a window of 380 px (the look lists a content width of 320 there), hover on the marks (they are not controls: cursor auto, no focusable element in the block), the production build output (LD-9 territory), a browser other than Chrome, kk by a native reader (ISS-0127).
